options.label: Login briefing
options.help: One quiet chat line when you log in: quests to hand in, repairs, mail on your alts, your note.

options.label: Lockouts at the entrance
options.help: When you enter a dungeon or raid, says which of your other characters are saved there.

options.label: Session coach
options.help: A small strip with this session's gold, experience and loot.

options.label: Hide the coach in combat
options.help: Steps out of the way while you fight.

options.label: Session card at logout
options.help: A short summary of the session during the logout countdown.

options.label: Marks in your bags
options.help: Coin and letter marks on items you marked to sell or send in Forever Buddy.

options.label: Your alts on item tooltips
options.help: Which of your other characters hold an item, and where.

options.label: Coordinates on the world map
options.help: Where you are, and where the cursor points, along the bottom of the world map.

options.label: Coordinates under the minimap
options.help: Where you are, in small numbers under the minimap.

options.label: Fade the world map while you move
options.help: The map turns see-through while you walk or ride, so you can see where you're going.

options.label: How much of the map shows while moving
Minimap button
options.help: Click to open Forever Buddy. Drag to move.

options.label: Record my next session
options.help: Numbers only: no names, chat or mail. Turns itself off when you log out.

lints.say: The world map almost disappears while you move.
